svg.text: Mulu (M-B) - acting states and the weather code
DEVELOPMENT EXPLORATION (PROP-0008) - not approved design, not reference art
Top Puff poses = body acting, never a power (Show Bible rule 2). The puff never detaches, splits or changes count.
Same poses at 64px: the Top Puff keeps the mood readable in silhouette.
Optional depletion states (story/comedy use only - not a meter, not tracked every shot)
Wisp - rained out / out of puff
The weather code: what leaves his body (rain from the flat base, drawn wind). Mild only.
Rain always falls straight down from the flat base, as countable teardrops. Wind is always drawn swirls plus at most three reacting objects.
